$comment: Catalog v2 (2026-07-29, DESIGN-V2.md) — 5 stores x 3 items, all 15 prices globally unique so any revealed amount identifies the item. class: V/W/B (villager/werebear/both) x off/def, or 'cover'. Effects resolve: venison > bearsbane/trap; musk > announcement; charm always saves the life. Economy: 50 XLM day-one buy-in, +15 XLM/day income (public deposits = self-auditing). Numbers await Bri+Patrick tweaks.

items.label: Hunting knife
items.effect: Your vote counts twice at today's trial (secret — shows only in the tally).

items.label: Bear trap
items.effect: If you are eaten, the werebear is wounded: it cannot kill the next night.

items.label: Silver charm
items.effect: Survive one night attack, publicly — the charm shatters on use. The werebear cannot buy it.

items.label: Lantern oil
items.effect: Posthumous: if you are eaten, Maude reveals one true fact about the werebear's purchases at dawn.

items.label: Fresh venison
items.effect: The werebear's next attack pierces bearsbane and bear traps. In villager hands: pure chaos.

items.label: Musk salve
items.effect: A failed attack tonight is not announced.

items.label: Bearsbane tincture
items.effect: Silently survive one night attack. Consumed; nobody is told.

items.label: A nip
items.effect: Cover. The cheapest alibi in town.

items.label: The good barrel
items.effect: Dead drunk: you cannot vote today and cannot be eaten tonight.

items.label: Votive candle
items.effect: Cover. A small light against a large problem.

items.label: St. Ursula's blessing
items.effect: Looks protective. The church makes no guarantees. (Ursula. From ursa. She knows.)
